# ScholarWorks@UARK

> ScholarWorks@UARK is the University of Arkansas institutional repository providing open access to scholarly works, research publications, student theses, and university records.

ScholarWorks@UARK serves as a comprehensive digital commons for the University of Arkansas community, aggregating faculty publications, graduate research, patents, and peer-reviewed journals. The repository is organized by colleges, departments, research centers, and institutes across the university.

## Key Topics

## Getting Started

- [ScholarWorks@UARK](https://scholarworks.uark.edu): ScholarWorks@UARK homepage showcasing University of Arkansas research repository
- [About Institutional Repositories](https://scholarworks.uark.edu/about.html): Information about ScholarWorks@UARK institutional repository and open access policy
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://scholarworks.uark.edu/faq.html): FAQ covering submission guidelines and repository usage for ScholarWorks@UARK

## Submit & Manage Research

- [Submit Your Research](https://scholarworks.uark.edu/submit_research.html): Guidelines and portal for submitting research to ScholarWorks@UARK
- [Please Log In](https://scholarworks.uark.edu/cgi/myaccount.cgi): User login and account management for ScholarWorks@UARK
- [Custom Email Notifications and RSS](https://scholarworks.uark.edu/announcements.html): Email notifications and RSS feed setup for ScholarWorks@UARK content alerts

## Browse Research Collections

- [Browse by Research Unit, Center, or Department](https://scholarworks.uark.edu/communities.html): Browse repository by departments and research units across University of Arkansas
- [Colleges and Departments](https://scholarworks.uark.edu/college_depts): Directory of colleges and departments in ScholarWorks@UARK repository
- [Centers and Institutes](https://scholarworks.uark.edu/centers_institutes): Directory of research centers and institutes at University of Arkansas
- [Student Works](https://scholarworks.uark.edu/studentpub_index): Collection of student theses, dissertations, and research from University of Arkansas

## Specialized Collections

- [Browse Journals and Peer-Reviewed Series](https://scholarworks.uark.edu/peer_review_list.html): Browse peer-reviewed journals and publications hosted by ScholarWorks@UARK
- [Patents Granted](https://scholarworks.uark.edu/pat): Database of patents granted to University of Arkansas faculty and researchers
- [University Records](https://scholarworks.uark.edu/uarec): Collection of University of Arkansas administrative and institutional records

## Discover & Analytics

- [Most Popular Papers](https://scholarworks.uark.edu/topdownloads.html): Most downloaded and viewed papers in ScholarWorks@UARK repository
- [Activity by Year](https://scholarworks.uark.edu/activity.html): Repository statistics and annual activity metrics for ScholarWorks@UARK

## Optional

- [Fatigue Performance and Shear Demand Distributions of Clustered Shear](https://scholarworks.uark.edu/etd/3059): Graduate thesis on composite bridge girder fatigue testing by Brian David Hillhouse
